remarks: Charming Cape Cod Retreat on 6 Private Wooded Acres  Tucked away on six secluded acres of lush woods with a picturesque pond, this charming Cape Cod-style home offers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. Located on prestigious Smith Ridge Road in New Canaan, you're just minutes from the Village, Irwin Park, Waveny Park, and the Merritt Parkway.  Enjoy serene strolls along a scenic path bordered by historic stone walls that lead to your very own peaceful pond - a perfect escape from the everyday.  This delightful home features two spacious bedrooms, three full baths, a home office or study, a cozy family room, a welcoming living room, and a bright eat-in kitchen. An attached garage, ample attic and storage space provide practical living, while a large back patio invites outdoor entertaining and special moments with friends and family.  Live the exceptional New Canaan lifestyle, known for its vibrant community and top-rated schools.  Note: A one-time, non-refundable pet fee of $250 applies. Restrictions on large dogs may apply.  Please note photos show prior occupants' belongings.
